options.name: Familiar
options.benefit: Bond permanently with a magical animal companion that improves with wizard level. If lost, dismissed, or killed, it can be replaced after 1 week with an 8-hour ritual costing 200 gp per wizard level.

powers.name: Alertness
powers.summary: Gain Alertness while the familiar is within arm's reach.

powers.name: Improved Evasion
powers.summary: The familiar takes no damage on a successful Reflex save for half damage and only half damage on a failed save.

powers.name: Share Spells
powers.summary: Cast spells with a target of you on the familiar as touch spells, even when they would not normally affect magical beasts.

powers.name: Empathic Link
powers.summary: Communicate general emotions with the familiar and share its connection to places and items within 1 mile.

powers.name: Deliver Touch Spells
powers.summary: The familiar can deliver a touch spell cast while it is in contact with the wizard.

powers.name: Speak with Master
powers.summary: The familiar and wizard can communicate verbally in a private shared language.

powers.name: Speak with Animals of Its Kind
powers.summary: The familiar can communicate with normal and dire animals of approximately its own kind.

powers.name: Spell Resistance
powers.summary: The familiar gains spell resistance equal to the wizard's level + 5.

powers.name: Scry on Familiar
powers.summary: Scry on the familiar once per day as the scrying spell.

options.name: Bonded Object
options.benefit: Bond permanently with a masterwork amulet, ring, staff, wand, or weapon received at no cost at 1st level.

powers.name: Additional Spell
powers.summary: Once per day, cast any one spell in the spellbook that you can cast even if it was not prepared; metamagic cannot modify this spell and opposition-school spells are excluded.

powers.name: Bond Dependency
powers.summary: Casting without the object worn or held requires a concentration check with DC 20 + spell level or the spell is lost.

powers.name: Item Creation
powers.summary: Add magical abilities to the bonded object as though you possessed the required item creation feats, while still meeting level prerequisites.

powers.name: Self-Repair
powers.summary: A damaged bonded object returns to full hit points the next time the wizard prepares spells.

powers.name: Replacement Ritual
powers.summary: Replace a lost or destroyed object after 1 week with an 8-hour ritual costing 200 gp per wizard level plus the masterwork item cost.
